name: @battuta/plugin-lyrics
description: The lyrics lane: type syllables at the caret, space or enter advances to the next note, - hyphenates a word across notes.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.
dependencies: @battuta/api and nothing else of the workspace. No react either — this plugin contributes a LANE, and the host owns the lane's floating editor; the plugin never renders.
